fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a {{tip|turret}} outside the enemy team's base is destroyed, a marker is placed above its ruins which can be targeted by '''Azir'''.
fields.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Disc of the Sun:}} '''Azir''' can select a marker to construct the {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} above the ruins after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]]. The {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} will activate after being assembled over 5 seconds.

'''''Azir''' cannot construct a {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} with the marker while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
fields.description3: The {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} functions the same as a standard [[Turret#Inner_turret|inner turret]] but deals {{as|magic damage}}, gains {{as|40% AP}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, and grants its kill credit to '''Azir'''. The {{as|Sun Disc's|buzzword2}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}} decays over 45 seconds and loses {{sti|armor|{{as|100 armor}}}} and {{sti|magic resistance|{{as|100 magic resistance}}}} while '''Azir''' is not alive or is too far away.
fields.description4: ''See [[Azir#Pets|Pets]] for more details about the {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}}.''

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
